bustSpanEase.name: Bust span ease (%)
bustSpanEase.help: Controls the amount of ease along the bust span

chestEase.name: Chest ease (%)
chestEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at the chest

fullChestEaseReduction.name: Full chest ease reduction (%)
fullChestEaseReduction.help: Allows you to independently reduce the ease around the chest to make it fit tight(er) in that area

shoulderToShoulderEase.name: Shoulder to shoulder ease (%)
shoulderToShoulderEase.help: Controls the amount of ease along the shoulder to shoulder measurement

waistEase.name: Waist ease (%)
waistEase.help: Controls the amount of ease at the waist

cuffEase.name: Cuff ease (%)
cuffEase.help: The amount of ease around the wrist (or arm, for shorter sleeves)

sleevecapEase.name: Sleevecap ease (%)
sleevecapEase.help: The amount by which the sleevecap seam is longer than the armhole seam.

bicepsEase.name: Biceps ease (%)
bicepsEase.help: The amount of ease at your upper arm. Note that while we try to respect this, fitting the sleeve to the armhole takes precedence over respecting the exact amount of ease.

lengthBonus.name: Length bonus (%)
lengthBonus.help: Increase or decrease the skirt length with respect to knee length

skirtWidthBonus.name: Skirt width bonus (%)
skirtWidthBonus.help: Increase or decrease the additional skirt width with respect to hip circumference

necklineDepth.name: Neckline depth (%)
necklineDepth.help: Control the depth of the neckline

necklineWidth.name: Neckline width (%)
necklineWidth.help: Control the width of the neckline

necklineBend.name: Neckline bend (%)
necklineBend.help: Change the shape of the neckline from V-neck to rounded to boxy

withPocket.name: With pocket
withPocket.help: Splits the front outside part to add a pocket

pocketCurve.name: Pocket opening curve (%)
pocketCurve.help: Controls the curvature of the pocket opening

pocketOpeningHeight.name: Pocket opening Height (%)
pocketOpeningHeight.help: Controls the vertical dimension of the pocket opening

sleeveLengthBonus.name: Sleeve length bonus (%)
sleeveLengthBonus.help: The amount to lengthen the sleeve. A negative value will shorten it.

backNeckCutout.name: Back neck cutout (%)
backNeckCutout.help: How deep the neck is cut out at the back

frontShoulderWidth.name: Front shoulder width (%)
frontShoulderWidth.help: Controls how much width is added to the shoulder in the front

highBustWidth.name: High bust width (%)
highBustWidth.help: Controls the width of the high bust

armholeDartCurvePoint.name: Armhole princess seam curve point (%)
armholeDartCurvePoint.help: This controls where (vertically) the curve of the princess seam starts

armholeDartCurveWidth.name: Armhole princess seam curve width (%)
armholeDartCurveWidth.help: This controls the radius of the curve of the princess seam

shoulderDartCurvature.name: Shoulder dart curvature (%)
shoulderDartCurvature.help: Controls the curvature of the upper part of the shoulder dart

shoulderDartPosition.name: Shoulder dart position (%)
shoulderDartPosition.help: Controls the position of the shoulder dart

armholeDartPositionBackOffset.name: Armhole dart position back offset (%)
armholeDartPositionBackOffset.help: Controls the position of the back armhole dart relative to that of the front

sleeveWidthGuarantee.name: Sleeve width guarantee (%)
sleeveWidthGuarantee.help: Controls how much of the sleeve width will be guaranteed. This determines how much we can alter the sleeve width to fit the sleeve in the armhole.

sleevecapTopFactorX.name: Sleevecap top X (%)
sleevecapTopFactorX.help: Controls the horizontal location of the sleevecap top.

sleevecapTopFactorY.name: Sleevecap top Y (%)
sleevecapTopFactorY.help: Controls the height of the sleevecap. A higher value results in a higher and more narrow sleevecap.

sleevecapBackFactorX.name: Sleevecap back X (%)
sleevecapBackFactorX.help: Controls the placement of the sleevecap back pitchpoint on the X-axis (horizontal)

sleevecapBackFactorY.name: Sleevecap back Y (%)
sleevecapBackFactorY.help: Controls the placement of the sleevecap back pitchpoint on the Y-axis (vertical)

sleevecapFrontFactorX.name: Sleevecap front X (%)
sleevecapFrontFactorX.help: Controls the placement of the sleevecap front pitchpoint on the X-axis (horizontal)

sleevecapFrontFactorY.name: Sleevecap front Y (%)
sleevecapFrontFactorY.help: Controls the placement of the sleevecap front pitchpoint on the Y-axis (vertical)

sleevecapQ1Offset.name: Sleevecap Q1 offset (%)
sleevecapQ1Offset.help: Controls the curvature of the sleevecap in the first quadrant (front armhole)

sleevecapQ2Offset.name: Sleevecap Q2 offset (%)
sleevecapQ2Offset.help: Controls the curvature of the sleevecap in the second quadrant (front shoulder)

sleevecapQ3Offset.name: Sleevecap Q3 offset (%)
sleevecapQ3Offset.help: Controls the curvature of the sleevecap in the third quadrant (back shoulder)

sleevecapQ4Offset.name: Sleevecap Q4 offset (%)
sleevecapQ4Offset.help: Controls the curvature of the sleevecap in the fourth quadrant (back armhole)

sleevecapQ1Spread1.name: Sleevecap Q1 downward spread (%)
sleevecapQ1Spread1.help: Controls the spread of the sleevecap first quadrant curvature towards the armhole

sleevecapQ1Spread2.name: Sleevecap Q1 upward spread (%)
sleevecapQ1Spread2.help: Controls the spread of the sleevecap first quadrant curvature towards the shoulder

sleevecapQ2Spread1.name: Sleevecap Q2 downward spread (%)
sleevecapQ2Spread1.help: Controls the spread of the sleevecap second quadrant curvature towards the armhole

sleevecapQ2Spread2.name: Sleevecap Q2 upward spread (%)
sleevecapQ2Spread2.help: Controls the spread of the sleevecap second quadrant curvature towards the shoulder

sleevecapQ3Spread1.name: Sleevecap Q3 upward spread (%)
sleevecapQ3Spread1.help: Controls the spread of the sleevecap third quadrant curvature towards the shoulder

sleevecapQ3Spread2.name: Sleevecap Q3 downward spread (%)
sleevecapQ3Spread2.help: Controls the spread of the sleevecap third quadrant curvature towards the armhole

sleevecapQ4Spread1.name: Sleevecap Q4 upward spread (%)
sleevecapQ4Spread1.help: Controls the spread of the sleevecap fourth quadrant curvature towards the shoulder

sleevecapQ4Spread2.name: Sleevecap Q4 downward spread (%)
sleevecapQ4Spread2.help: Controls the spread of the sleevecap fourth quadrant curvature towards the armhole

armholeDepth.name: Armhole depth (%)
armholeDepth.help: Controls the depth of the armhole. Higher values make a deeper armhole.

backArmholeCurvature.name: Back armhole curvature (%)
backArmholeCurvature.help: Controls how deep the armhole is scooped out at the back

backArmholePitchDepth.name: Back armhole pitch depth (%)
backArmholePitchDepth.help: Controls how deep the armhole cuts into the back

backArmholeSlant.name: Back armhole slant (°)
backArmholeSlant.help: Controls the slant of the armhole at the back

frontArmholeCurvature.name: Front armhole curvature (%)
frontArmholeCurvature.help: Controls how deep the armhole is scooped out at the front bottom

frontArmholePitchDepth.name: Front armhole pitch depth (%)
frontArmholePitchDepth.help: Controls how deep the armhole cuts into the front

backDartHeight.name: Back dart height (%)
backDartHeight.help: Controls the height of the back dart

waistDartLength.name: Waist dart length (%)
waistDartLength.help: Controls the length of the waist dart

armholeDartCurved.name: Princess Seam Curviness
armholeDartCurved.help: Controls the curvature of the princess seam

armholeDartPosition.name: Armhole dart position (%)
armholeDartPosition.help: Controls the position of the armhole dart

upperDartLength.name: Upper dart length (%)
upperDartLength.help: Controls the length of the upper dart

waistdartposition.name: Waist dart position (%)
waistdartposition.help: Controls the position of the waist 'dart', moving it to the center (negative) or side (positive)
